newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales off 0.5 pct--BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales off 0.5 pct--BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales fell 0.5 percent in the week ended May 31 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 2.8 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index slipped 0.5 percent from the prior month.

"One retailer noted that during the week business was generally better in parts of the country where the weather was favorable -- a reflection of the problem retailers faced throughout the month," the report said.
